Zadie: Zadie has a massive bookshelf at home which is choc-full. She'll get around to them, sure, although she's never at home. She’s only read a third of them.
Zahara: The name of a pilot whose peers describe as being something of a cowboy. Yes, not just anyone can get their commercial pilot's licence, but we're concerned at the number of times she's had to ditch an aircraft into the sea because it ran out of fuel. It's happened so often that she's actually quite good at it now. Certainly, no ones even been badly injured yet. Have they?
Zahli: Zahli loves being in the middle of a crowd, though not necessarily the reason for its existence. She'd go nuts in a one-horse town.
Zali: Refreshing and upbeat like a freshly squeezed fruit juice that has a heap of ginger in it, Zali is healthy, different and enlivening.
Zambia: Well, I suppose they could have called her Angola or Equatorial Guinea, so that's a relief, eh? Zambia takes ages to get going, or to figure out what she wants. Make-up - why all the make-up, though? Her sunnies are so large that we can hardly tell who we’re looking at. Girl, take them off, get your bearings and then come with me into the Life Path Office so we can have a chat...
Zan: Sensual, passionate and inquisitive, Zan never criticises unless she's been through the same ordeal. Even then, her rather sage approach arise from empathy rather than chastisement, because she's screwed things up nearly as much as anyone.
Zana: No, she's not a white supremacist, but if she was one she'd be lethal, only because if she takes a stance on something her ego propels her towards the strongest stance possible. In life she's not racist, but she's definitely a 'slackist'. That's right - if she gives you a job to do (and let's face it, she's a wonderful delegator) and you don't do it, or try to worm your way out of it, she'll be onto you in a flash. You’ll probably get a dressing down in public.
Zaneisha: As a young girl Zaneisha was truly happy when she was out with the boys, wallowing in and getting covered in mud. When she was really young she used to eat it. As an adult now, she still secretly yearns for playful, silly moments of chaos that metaphorically or otherwise toss mud and dirt all over the place. Overly serious chores or attitudes just ain't her. Amen.
Zara: Zara, it's true, yes, that generally men will come to you. But once in a while, you're going to have to make the move. He'll be worth it so don't worry, you'll be right……(ps-She hasn't quite arrived at the notion that outrageous behaviour often results in greatness.)
Zardi: Zardi will never ever need to visit a shrink. Indeed, perhaps she should become one, but then she'd spend her days stuck indoors listening to sad and confused people. Sure, she'd do some good, but what about everyone else who'd miss out on her company?
Zarlah:
Too proud to beg. Not bright enough to commit a crime. Zarlah will follow the herd.
Up here in the commentary box we think it’s time she left home and jumped out into the world. Get some dirt on you, girl. Poke your head into dangerous corners and think for yourself!
Zaskia: The only reason she'll get married is for a Big, Fat Diamond.
Zayla: Wow, you don't see this every day. The eagle chick has been flapping her wings in the eerie for a while now and under the watchful eye of her mum, it seems she is ready. She stands at the edge and opens her wings. The warm afternoon breeze fills them and with the wind over her face, she can feel the lift they generate. For the first time she jumps. Zayla is the name given to an eagle's first moments of flight and time seems to stop...
Zebedee:
Zebedee is not an intellectual juggernaut but she  loves dancing, until she's directed to dance in a choreographic routine. On her own at the club, yep, she can shake it and roll it with the best of them but put her in a group setting, say, for an audition, and she'd struggle. (And no, she's not on her own in that regard.) 
Moral to the story: Don't try to limit her creative expression!
Zeina: Zeina's bedroom has more photos of Brad Pitt on its walls and ceiling than any other in the Kingdom, which partially explians why she works at the ticket booth at the cinema.
Zelda: Wow! Where'd she go? A minute ago she was kissing that DJ. Isn't she supposed to be the captain of this ship? How's she got time to kiss the musos?? Oh my God! Look at her now! Hunting that young man on the dance floor! Who is in control of the vessel??? ZELDA!!!! CONTROL YOUR URGES AND GET BACK TO WORK!!!!
Zelka: Zelka keeps her family on an even keel, bracing them for any weather, usually without them even knowing. It takes a lot of work behind the scenes to keep the company together and happy. If only they knew the hours she puts in for them…
Zena:
Zena walks through the door as a teenager, throws her bag on the table and a handgun and knife fall out onto the floor. Her father shakes his head.
“Darling, tell me you’ve got a licence for that gun?”
“Sure Dad,” she says, smiling.
He just nods. He knows she can look after herself.
Zenda: The director of a reputable and compassionate funeral service company.
Zenela: Zenela is the name of a drive in the country with a couple of friend’s friends, who turned up two days ago and are now struggling to find something to do. You read the bible where as they do drugs and partake in strange sex acts, or vice versa, and the whole thing is awkward and dysfunctional.
Zenia:
"Okay, so Zenia, you've booked yourself on a ski trip to Canada, which is great. Have you ever skiid before?" 
"Nah," she says, chewing her gum loudly and looking distracted.
"Right, so, do you think you'll enjoy it?"
"Oh, I don't really care about the skiing."
"....Huh?"
"I just want to look like a ski bunny and kiss a cute Norwegian (Australian, probably) ski instructor."
"Rrrrright. So, who's paying for all this?"
"Ah, Daddy, I think. I'm not sure."
Indeed.
Zenovia:
Zenovia's method for eating watermelon: 

1. She places the untouched fruit squarely on the chopping block, takes a few moments to get her stance correct and to feel the weight of the machete in her hand, and to compose herself. 

2. She raises the weapon over her head (she stole it from a giant African black man she had an affair with, years ago) and takes a big breath. 

3. Screaming like a Japanese Samurai warrior, she does one almighty chop in the middle of the watermelon, splitting it in two, then quickly steps to the right and performs another chop on one of the halves still rocking. 

4. She tosses the machete aside, lunges for one of the quarters and, with both hands, buries her face into the juicy flesh where she feasts in a fashion not dissimilar to a Scandinavian Viking eating a roasted turkey. 

The End.
Zettie: Zettie never stays in one place or thought pattern long enough to get depressed. She's as busy as a beaver this one and spends all her time racing around like an amicable wasp trying to figure out where the clan should settle next.
Zia: Zia wears metallic finger nail polish with lots of glitter.
Zion: Zion is one of the few people in the Kingdom who had the balls and foresight to confiscate the weed off their parents. They were smoking way too much and sometimes even forgot to take her to school. And things haven't changed, hence Zion isn't as 'out there' as you'd imagine. She's a class warrior, that one.
Zita: As a kitchen Bamix she looks cool and curvy, even though she doesn’t do much until she is stimulated into action in some way. If that happens then either stand back or take care.
Zoe: When she’s not a princess-in-waiting, she’s a princess-proper. Everyone flippantly assumes she is conceited and arrogant but they’d never tell her because, deep down, if they stopped and thought about it, they’d know that this is untrue and that this news would kill her if she ever found out.  Zoe is never that nasty.
Zoey: Like a succulent chunk of tropical fruit, Zoey is memorable and sensual. She holds her opinions in front of your face if the moment requires it, but she’ll let things slide if need be as well. A lover of social fun more than most, Zoey embraces strangers and often forms the core around which many gatherings rotate. Zoey never lacks followers – be they romantic or otherwise – and rarely does she spend days on end on her own.
Zoi: Warmer and more forgiving than her cooler cousin (Zoe), Zoi has had a late start but she makes up for it. She'd be good at identifying niche markets for a new start-up, just as she'd predict the impending emotional breakdown of a friend and have rescue plans already set in place for when it happens. She'd even do it for an acquaintance, for this girl has a heart. Cute dimples.
Zorette: Christ, you ready? If she were a marksman she'd be deadly. Zorette is the kind of girl who'll go to Mexico and, having only seen it on TV, will jump off a 100 foot cliff into the ocean on a whim. Is she crazy? Maybe, but that's her job, God love her.
ZsaZsa: Elizabeth Taylor, Kelly Slater, De Niro, Redford and Madonna - some names shouldn’t be replicated for the sake of popularism, and Zsa Zsa is one of those. Unless it’s a nickname of course, in which case, ZZ is a curvy, loud and hilarious chunk of overly laid-on sexuality and bravado, and by god she does it well. (If it’s an actual given name…then we don’t even want to go there. Have a nice day.)
Zsusanna: Zsusanna knows things about Lawrence that his wife has no idea about.
Zyan: 80% of her body is covered by tattoos, which is fine, but now what?
